title: AlphaDog Styles Women's Racerback Tank - Dog Breed Line Art Heart, Front Emblem and Full Body Back Print
desc:
Wear your best friend. Minimalist continuous line art with a heart of your dog's breed on a soft women's racerback tank: a small emblem portrait on the front and the full body drawing across the back.

HOW TO ORDER
1. Style: pick your breed.
2. Color: pick the color.
3. Size: pick your size.

FABRIC AND FIT: Next Level 1533 women's ideal racerback tank, about 3.9 oz cotton/polyester blend, slim racerback cut that sits close to the body - size up for a looser fit.

DETAILS
- Printed in the USA, made to order just for you.
- Finished with the AlphaDog Styles logo label.
- Production 2-5 business days, then 3-7 business days in transit within the US. Tracking included.

CARE
Machine wash cold, inside out, with similar colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron or dry clean the print.
